annotations.title: Let a position's stop follow the price

description: Make a held position's stop-loss move by itself, only ever toward the price: trailing (it follows the best price at trail_pct behind it) or breakeven (it moves to the entry once the price reaches activate_at). TradeHub checks about every 5 seconds; each move follows tighten_stop_loss's rules and is audited. Use to lock in profit on a winning position. One rule per position: a new one replaces it, kind=none removes it, it ends when the position closes. Not for a one-off move (use tighten_stop_loss). Next: get_my_open_positions shows the rule.

activate_at.description: Price, USD per coin, from which the rule acts; required for breakeven (beyond the entry on the profit side), optional for trailing
activate_at.title: Activate At

kind.description: trailing: the stop follows the best price at trail_pct behind it; breakeven: the stop moves to the entry once the price reaches activate_at; none: remove the rule
kind.title: Kind

trail_pct.description: trailing only: distance behind the best price as a fraction, 0.001-0.2 (0.02 = 2%)
trail_pct.title: Trail Pct

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid, else your only connected venue, else sandbox
venue.title: Venue
